applicability: Unsigned ADC hysteresis controller with inclusive fault boundaries, retained state between thresholds, and a nominal ideal resistive load-switch circuit.
limitations: ADC range is bounded to 65535 for exhaustive verification.
JavaScript simulation, optional native host C, and optional command-line ngspice DC measurements; no MCU execution or physical board evidence.
Ideal switch excludes transistor selection, dynamics, thermal constraints, measurement uncertainty, and hardware safety.

parameter_schema.fault_low/off_threshold/on_threshold/fau: Strictly ordered integer thresholds within ADC bounds
parameter_schema.supply_v/load_ohm/on_ohm/off_ohm: Positive finite circuit values; off_ohm > on_ohm
